parsed.reason: The loader does run under the lock, so slow loads serialize all lookups and a reentrant call would deadlock, which are real concerns; but the comment itself says the miss-count behaviour is acceptable and the throughput hazard is a design trade-off not a concrete defect demonstrated in this code, so it is best classed as a nit.
